tools.name: mcp/read
tools.description: Read. A read is a path, or {path, care, case, formula, settings, limit, next, present}: care x the record, y the record and its children (default), z the subtree; case 0 live (default) or a case to read as of then; formula runs a standard cell over the tree read with settings as its context, nothing written; limit nodes per answer in tap order, default 100, never over 500; next the cursor a previous page answered; present answers as usual and pushes {shown} on the stream, journaling nothing. One snapshot, zero events. Answers the tree: path, exists, reference, properties, children, nodes, next; a value that is code or over 8 KB is {type, size, reference}; a reply that would pass 2 MB is refused: page it.

path.description: Segmented namespace address, absolute (/<node>/...) or relative to the node. Derived addresses read too: /x/<cell> is a cell's result, /c/x/<cell> its context (parameters, /sys/view/missing, /sys/view/fault), /h/<care>/<case>/<len>/<path> a pinned view.

reads.description: Several reads in one call ([a read, ...]): answers in order, each the shape a single read gives; a failed entry answers {path, error} without failing the call.

case.description: 0 live (default), or a case to read as of then.

formula.description: A standard cell to run over the tree read; nothing written.

settings.description: The formula's parameters, slot names to values.

limit.description: Nodes per answer, in tap order (a node, then its children by name). Default 100, never over 500.

next.description: The next cursor a previous page of this same read answered: the page after it.

present.description: Answer as usual and push {shown: {path, care, case}} on the stream; nothing journaled, no epoch moves.

tools.name: mcp/write
tools.description: Write: one event however many records; admitted whole or refused whole. Values are text, numbers, booleans, or {type, value} with type nat, str, bool, path or reference (/h/<care>/<case>/<len>/<path>; case 0 is live). A culled path refuses writes beneath it until the culled record is written again: delete-and-recreate is one batch.

records.description: [{path, slots, action}, ...]: action make (default: the whole record, creating or replacing it), poke (merge slots), cull (delete the subtree).

from.description: On a record: /h/x/<case>/<len>/<path>, copy the record as it was at that case (undo, redo).

then.description: [a read, ...] answered on the admitted state in the same reply.

who.description: The writer's tag, default mcp; the event carries it.

tools.name: mcp/history
tools.description: History. With a path: the record's cases newest first with references and slots. Without one: the event log, each event {epoch, who, touched, touched_count, with}; after <epoch> pages forward (oldest first, next is the last epoch given), before <epoch> backward; with x|y inlines each event's written records as they were at that epoch (a written cell's /x and /c/x too); presented reads appear once as {shown, epoch}. Inert.

path.description: Segmented namespace address, absolute (/<node>/...) or relative to the node. Derived addresses read too: /x/<cell> is a cell's result, /c/x/<cell> its context (parameters, /sys/view/missing, /sys/view/fault), /h/<care>/<case>/<len>/<path> a pinned view.

after.description: Events after this epoch, oldest first: resume from where you left off (next is the last epoch given).

before.description: Events before this epoch, newest first.

limit.description: Cases or events per page. Default 40, never over 200.

with.description: x or y: each event's written records ride in it as of that epoch, 500 nodes per event.

who.description: Writers to list: absent, every writer but system; all; or one writer's id.

tools.name: mcp/apply
tools.description: Apply a declared /op to the record with transient inputs: one event. then takes reads.

path.description: Segmented namespace address, absolute (/<node>/...) or relative to the node. Derived addresses read too: /x/<cell> is a cell's result, /c/x/<cell> its context (parameters, /sys/view/missing, /sys/view/fault), /h/<care>/<case>/<len>/<path> a pinned view.

inputs.description: Argument slots to values, encoded as for write.

then.description: [a read, ...] answered on the admitted state in the same reply.

tools.name: mcp/read
tools.description: Read. A read is a path, or {path, care, case, formula, settings, limit, next, present}: care x the record, y the record and its children (default), z the subtree; case 0 live (default) or a case to read as of then; formula runs a standard cell over the tree read with settings as its context, nothing written; limit nodes per answer in tap order, default 100, never over 500; next the cursor a previous page answered; present answers as usual and pushes {shown} on the stream, journaling nothing. One snapshot, zero events. Answers the tree: path, exists, reference, properties, children, nodes, next; a value that is code or over 8 KB is {type, size, reference}; a reply that would pass 2 MB is refused: page it.

path.description: Segmented namespace address, absolute (/<node>/...) or relative to the node. Derived addresses read too: /x/<cell> is a cell's result, /c/x/<cell> its context (parameters, /sys/view/missing, /sys/view/fault), /h/<care>/<case>/<len>/<path> a pinned view.

reads.description: Several reads in one call ([a read, ...]): answers in order, each the shape a single read gives; a failed entry answers {path, error} without failing the call.

case.description: 0 live (default), or a case to read as of then.

formula.description: A standard cell to run over the tree read; nothing written.

settings.description: The formula's parameters, slot names to values.

limit.description: Nodes per answer, in tap order (a node, then its children by name). Default 100, never over 500.

next.description: The next cursor a previous page of this same read answered: the page after it.

present.description: Answer as usual and push {shown: {path, care, case}} on the stream; nothing journaled, no epoch moves.

tools.name: mcp/write
tools.description: Write: one event however many records; admitted whole or refused whole. Values are text, numbers, booleans, or {type, value} with type nat, str, bool, path or reference (/h/<care>/<case>/<len>/<path>; case 0 is live). A culled path refuses writes beneath it until the culled record is written again: delete-and-recreate is one batch.

records.description: [{path, slots, action}, ...]: action make (default: the whole record, creating or replacing it), poke (merge slots), cull (delete the subtree).

from.description: On a record: /h/x/<case>/<len>/<path>, copy the record as it was at that case (undo, redo).

then.description: [a read, ...] answered on the admitted state in the same reply.

who.description: The writer's tag, default mcp; the event carries it.

tools.name: mcp/history
tools.description: History. With a path: the record's cases newest first with references and slots. Without one: the event log, each event {epoch, who, touched, touched_count, with}; after <epoch> pages forward (oldest first, next is the last epoch given), before <epoch> backward; with x|y inlines each event's written records as they were at that epoch (a written cell's /x and /c/x too); presented reads appear once as {shown, epoch}. Inert.

path.description: Segmented namespace address, absolute (/<node>/...) or relative to the node. Derived addresses read too: /x/<cell> is a cell's result, /c/x/<cell> its context (parameters, /sys/view/missing, /sys/view/fault), /h/<care>/<case>/<len>/<path> a pinned view.

after.description: Events after this epoch, oldest first: resume from where you left off (next is the last epoch given).

before.description: Events before this epoch, newest first.

limit.description: Cases or events per page. Default 40, never over 200.

with.description: x or y: each event's written records ride in it as of that epoch, 500 nodes per event.

who.description: Writers to list: absent, every writer but system; all; or one writer's id.

tools.name: mcp/apply
tools.description: Apply a declared /op to the record with transient inputs: one event. then takes reads.

path.description: Segmented namespace address, absolute (/<node>/...) or relative to the node. Derived addresses read too: /x/<cell> is a cell's result, /c/x/<cell> its context (parameters, /sys/view/missing, /sys/view/fault), /h/<care>/<case>/<len>/<path> a pinned view.

inputs.description: Argument slots to values, encoded as for write.

then.description: [a read, ...] answered on the admitted state in the same reply.

tools.name: mcp/read
tools.description: Read. A read is a path, or {path, care, case, formula, settings, limit, next, present}: care x the record, y the record and its children (default), z the subtree; case 0 live (default) or a case to read as of then; formula runs a standard cell over the tree read with settings as its context, nothing written; limit nodes per answer in tap order, default 100, never over 500; next the cursor a previous page answered; present answers as usual and pushes {shown} on the stream, journaling nothing. One snapshot, zero events. Answers the tree: path, exists, reference, properties, children, nodes, next; a value that is code or over 8 KB is {type, size, reference}; a reply that would pass 2 MB is refused: page it.

path.description: Segmented namespace address, absolute (/<node>/...) or relative to the node. Derived addresses read too: /x/<cell> is a cell's result, /c/x/<cell> its context (parameters, /sys/view/missing, /sys/view/fault), /h/<care>/<case>/<len>/<path> a pinned view.

reads.description: Several reads in one call ([a read, ...]): answers in order, each the shape a single read gives; a failed entry answers {path, error} without failing the call.

case.description: 0 live (default), or a case to read as of then.

formula.description: A standard cell to run over the tree read; nothing written.

settings.description: The formula's parameters, slot names to values.

limit.description: Nodes per answer, in tap order (a node, then its children by name). Default 100, never over 500.

next.description: The next cursor a previous page of this same read answered: the page after it.

present.description: Answer as usual and push {shown: {path, care, case}} on the stream; nothing journaled, no epoch moves.

tools.name: mcp/write
tools.description: Write: one event however many records; admitted whole or refused whole. Values are text, numbers, booleans, or {type, value} with type nat, str, bool, path or reference (/h/<care>/<case>/<len>/<path>; case 0 is live). A culled path refuses writes beneath it until the culled record is written again: delete-and-recreate is one batch.

records.description: [{path, slots, action}, ...]: action make (default: the whole record, creating or replacing it), poke (merge slots), cull (delete the subtree).

from.description: On a record: /h/x/<case>/<len>/<path>, copy the record as it was at that case (undo, redo).

then.description: [a read, ...] answered on the admitted state in the same reply.

who.description: The writer's tag, default mcp; the event carries it.

tools.name: mcp/history
tools.description: History. With a path: the record's cases newest first with references and slots. Without one: the event log, each event {epoch, who, touched, touched_count, with}; after <epoch> pages forward (oldest first, next is the last epoch given), before <epoch> backward; with x|y inlines each event's written records as they were at that epoch (a written cell's /x and /c/x too); presented reads appear once as {shown, epoch}. Inert.

path.description: Segmented namespace address, absolute (/<node>/...) or relative to the node. Derived addresses read too: /x/<cell> is a cell's result, /c/x/<cell> its context (parameters, /sys/view/missing, /sys/view/fault), /h/<care>/<case>/<len>/<path> a pinned view.

after.description: Events after this epoch, oldest first: resume from where you left off (next is the last epoch given).

before.description: Events before this epoch, newest first.

limit.description: Cases or events per page. Default 40, never over 200.

with.description: x or y: each event's written records ride in it as of that epoch, 500 nodes per event.

who.description: Writers to list: absent, every writer but system; all; or one writer's id.

tools.name: mcp/apply
tools.description: Apply a declared /op to the record with transient inputs: one event. then takes reads.

path.description: Segmented namespace address, absolute (/<node>/...) or relative to the node. Derived addresses read too: /x/<cell> is a cell's result, /c/x/<cell> its context (parameters, /sys/view/missing, /sys/view/fault), /h/<care>/<case>/<len>/<path> a pinned view.

inputs.description: Argument slots to values, encoded as for write.

then.description: [a read, ...] answered on the admitted state in the same reply.
